module.title: Stylish Shop
module.description: A Persona 5-inspired shop interface for FoundryVTT.

currencyDefinitions.menuHint: Define sheet and virtual currencies for shop transactions. Shared across all GlitchSmith modules via the library.

catalogCategories.menuHint: Create and order the shared departments used by the desktop shop editor and smartphone marketplace.

displayStats.menuHint: Add custom stat boxes to every shop's item detail panel. Configured globally per world; applies to all shops.

itemPricePaths.menuHint: Set world-level item price data paths for unsupported systems. Applies to every Stylish Shop in this world.

itemRarityPath.menuHint: Set the world-level item data path Stylish Shop uses to read each item's rarity for the active system. Leave empty to use the built-in system adapter only.

actorsWallet.menuHint: Adjust virtual currency balances across all player characters in one place. Useful for granting credits, settling debts, or rewarding the party. Sheet currencies (system coins) are managed on each actor sheet.

shopDirectory.menuHint: Browse configured public shops without using a token or proximity prompt. GMs can see every configured shop.

discord.menuHint: Join the GlitchSmith Discord server for support, feedback, and updates.

soundVolume.name: Sound Effect Volume
soundVolume.hint: Volume level for shop sound effects (0 = silent, 1 = full volume).

soundEnabled.name: Enable Sound Effects
soundEnabled.hint: Play sound effects when navigating the shop and making purchases.

currencyExchangeEnabled.name: Enable Currency Exchange
currencyExchangeEnabled.hint: Allow players to exchange currencies from Stylish Shop. Disable this when instant denomination conversion does not fit the world's economy or tone.

defaultThemePreset.name: Default Theme Preset
defaultThemePreset.hint: The default color theme applied to new shops.

interactionRange.name: Shop Interaction Range
interactionRange.hint: Maximum distance (in grid squares) from which a player can interact with a shop NPC.

relationshipBenefitPreset.name: Relationship Benefit Starting Values
relationshipBenefitPreset.hint: Choose the rank discounts added when an empty shop enables Relationship benefits for the first time. Existing shop settings are never replaced.

headerButtonsIconOnly.name: Sheet Header Buttons: Icons Only
headerButtonsIconOnly.hint: Show Stylish Shop's Application V1 sheet header buttons, plus the GlitchSmith Library Wallet button, as icons without text labels. Useful when a system or multiple modules crowd the sheet header.

settingsCenter.menuHint: Manage world defaults, personal preferences, and shop administration tools in one organized window.
settingsCenter.title: Global Settings
settingsCenter.subtitleGm: World settings affect everyone; personal settings apply only to this client.
settingsCenter.subtitlePlayer: Personal settings apply only to this client.

shopDefaults.title: Shop Defaults
shopDefaults.description: Shared defaults for newly created shops and player interaction.

economy.title: Economy
economy.description: Choose which optional money services players can use in Stylish Shop.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Choose whether Stylish Shop plays interface sounds and how loud they are.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Keep sheet controls compact when header space is limited.

management.title: World Management
management.description: Configure shared shop data without searching through separate module-setting cards.

quick.title: Quick Links
quick.description: Open the shop directory or GlitchSmith community directly.

settingsCenter.saveFailed: Stylish Shop settings could not be saved.
settingsCenter.gmOnly: Only a GM can open this world-management tool.

exchange.title: Currency Exchange
exchange.heading: Currency Exchange
exchange.description: Convert {actor}'s on-hand currency using the rates set for this world.
exchange.enterAmount: Enter an amount to see the exchange quote.
exchange.rounding: The result was rounded down to the target currency's smallest valid unit.

exchange.onHandNote: This changes on-hand sheet or virtual currency. Smartphone bank balances are exchanged in Banking.

exchange.disabled: Currency exchange is disabled for this world.

errors.currencyRequired: Choose the source and target currencies.
errors.currencyNotFound: One of the selected currencies is no longer available.
errors.invalidRate: One of these currencies has an invalid exchange rate.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount that matches the source currency's smallest valid unit.

errors.numericOverflow: That amount is too large to exchange safely.
errors.actorNotFound: The buyer character could not be found.

errors.insufficientBalance: There is not enough of the source currency.
errors.invalidBalance: The current balance does not match the currency's smallest valid unit.
errors.balanceChanged: The balance changed before the exchange finished. Review it and try again.

giftProgram.title: Complimentary Gifts
giftProgram.hint: Your purchases at this shop advance these rewards. Claiming a gift does not count as another purchase.

keybind.interactHint: Open the nearest shop NPC's store when standing within range.
keybind.openDirectoryHint: Open the tokenless shop directory. No default key is assigned; set one here if your table wants it.

interaction.noToken: Select or control a token first.

config.title: Shop Settings — {shopName}

preview.ctrlClickHint: Tip: Ctrl+click any preview element to open Shop Settings at its matching field.

config.previewFieldNoMatch: No matching shop config field for that element.

audioTab.bgmHint: Plays automatically when this shop opens. Loops until shop closes.
audioTab.bgmTrackHint: Pick an audio file from your Foundry world (ogg/mp3/wav).
audioTab.sfxHint: Per-shop SFX overrides. Leave blank to use the theme default.
audioTab.sfxOverridesHint: Override individual sound effects with your own files.

identity.name: Name
identity.nameHint: Wrap text in **double asterisks** to accent.
identity.subtitle: Subtitle
identity.publicShopHint: Players can open this shop from the tokenless Shop Directory. GMs always see all configured shops.
identity.entryGKeyHint: Players within the interaction range can use the shop interaction key to open this shop.
identity.entryDoubleClickHint: Players within the interaction range can double-click this shop token to open it.
identity.tokenOnlyNotice: This shop is saved on this unlinked token. It appears in the Shop Directory only while the token is on the current scene.
identity.directoryArtHint: Optional override for the image shown on this shop's Shop Directory card. Leave empty to fall back to the NPC art (then the Actor portrait).

themeTab.typographyHint: Replace individual font families used by this theme. Leave a field at its theme default to preserve the original design.

categoriesTab.headerVarianceHint: Per-item price variance. Leave blank to use the shop default, 0 to disable variance for this item, or 1-100 for an item-specific percent.
categoriesTab.noCategories: No categories yet. Click "Add Category" to start.
categoriesTab.serviceBadgeHint: Service entry — runs a macro instead of granting an item.

requirements.label: Requirements
requirements.dropHint: Drag an item or material here to fill this requirement automatically.
requirements.uuidHint: Linked item UUID. Filled automatically when you drop an item; edit only for advanced manual linking.
requirements.consumeHint: Remove the required quantity from the buyer when they purchase. Leave off to only gate the purchase.

unlockSpend.label: Unlock after spend
unlockSpend.hint: Lock this item until the buyer has spent this much at this shop. Once unlocked, it stays available. Leave blank for no lock.

unlockPurchases.label: Purchase stamp unlock
unlockPurchases.hint: Each successful purchase at this shop adds one stamp, regardless of quantity. Repeatable rewards relock after this item is purchased.

unlockRank.label: Unlock at Relationship state and rank
unlockRank.none: No Relationship state and rank lock
unlockRank.hint: Lock this item until the linked Relationship matches the selected state and reaches its rank.
unlockRank.noRanks: Add and save a Relationship benefit in the Promotions tab before assigning an item lock.

displayStatsDialog.title: Stylish Shop — Display Stats
displayStatsDialog.tabAllHint: Stats here apply to every item type. Useful for universal fields like Weight or Rarity.
displayStatsDialog.tabTypeHint: Stats here apply only to items of type
displayStatsDialog.noItemTypes: Could not detect item types for this system. You can still add stats manually by entering paths.
displayStatsDialog.emptyAll: No universal stats yet. Click "Add Stat" to create one that applies to every item type.
displayStatsDialog.emptyType: No stats configured for this item type yet. Click "Add Stat" to create one.

chatNotifications.title: Chat Notifications
chatNotifications.purchaseHint: Post a chat message after a successful purchase.
chatNotifications.sellHint: Post a chat message after a successful sale.

itemPricePathsDialog.title: Item Price Paths
itemPricePathsDialog.hint: Configure item price data paths for the active system. Current system:

modes.completeHint: One item field already contains the whole price.
modes.currencyAmountsHint: Each coin has its own amount field.
modes.amountUnitHint: The price is stored as one amount field and one unit field.

itemPricePathsDialog.specPathHint: Optional. Use when the item stores a full price string like "5gp" or "5 gp", or one object containing currency keys.
itemPricePathsDialog.currencyAmountPathsHint: Use these when each currency lives at a different item path, such as gp/sp/cp fields. Filled rows are combined into one price.
itemPricePathsDialog.amountPathHint: Use this when each item price is stored in one unit at a time, such as value = 5 and denomination = gp.
itemPricePathsDialog.defaultUnitHint: Used when the currency path is empty or the item does not store a currency unit.

itemRarityPathDialog.title: Item Rarity Path
itemRarityPathDialog.hint: Set where this system stores each item's rarity. Current system:
itemRarityPathDialog.builtInHint: Leave blank to use the built-in adapter for this system. Built-in path:
itemRarityPathDialog.noBuiltInHint: No built-in rarity path is known for this system. Enter the dot-notation path this system uses to store each item's rarity.

config.restockAllHint: Reset every item's stock to its configured maximum and refresh generated variance prices.
config.restockConfirm: Reset every item's current stock back to its configured maximum and refresh generated variance prices?
config.deleteShopConfirm: Remove Stylish Shop configuration from {actorName}? This deletes categories, stock, theme, directory settings, and every buyer's spend, complimentary-gift, and purchase-stamp progress. The Actor, Token, and Items are not deleted.
config.deleteShopFailed: Could not remove shop setup — see console.
config.shopWalletHint: Set the shop's available funds directly. Edits write to the actor's currency on save.
config.shopWalletUpdateFailed: Could not update shop wallet — see console.
config.dropItemHere: Drag items here to add them to this category
config.itemMergeStackHint: If checked, buying this item again merges into the existing stack (quantity +1) instead of creating a separate inventory entry. Leave off for equipment like weapons/armor where each instance should stay separate.
config.useGlitchsmithLibHint: When enabled, this shop also accepts virtual currencies from glitchsmith-lib alongside the game system's native currency (gp/sp/cp etc). Each item's price spec unit decides which currency it costs. Wallet balances and shop displays will show both system and library currencies combined.
config.useSmartphoneBankHint: When enabled, purchases and sell payouts use each actor's primary Smartphone Banking account instead of on-hand sheet or wallet balances. Prices still use this shop's configured currencies.
config.useSmartphoneBankUnavailableHint: This shop is set to use Smartphone Banking, but Smartphone Widget Banking is not available. Uncheck this to return to on-hand balances.
config.openCurrencySettingsHint: Currency definitions are managed centrally by GlitchSmith Library. Edit them once and all GlitchSmith modules use the same set.
config.libCurrencyMenuMissing: Currency settings menu not found. Make sure GlitchSmith Library is active.

dialog.title: Set Shop Price
dialog.hint: Sheet currencies (gp, sp, etc.) write directly to the item's native cost field — same as editing on the item sheet. Virtual currencies are saved as a Stylish Shop override flag. Per-shop overrides still win; system native is the fallback.
dialog.noCurrencies: No currencies are defined yet. Open Currency Settings via Game Settings → GlitchSmith Library → Currency Definitions.
dialog.multiNativeWarn: This item has a multi-currency native price. Saving here will overwrite it with a single value.
dialog.savedNative: Wrote {spec} to the item's native price field.
dialog.savedFlag: Saved {spec} as a Stylish Shop override flag.
dialog.cleared: Item shop price override flag cleared.
dialog.invalidValue: Price must be a non-negative integer.

dialog.title: Item Description
dialog.hint: Override the system-extracted description for this shop entry. Leave the editor empty to fall back to the source item's description.
dialog.noAuto: No description could be extracted from the source item.
dialog.overrideHint: Supports rich text. Saved per-shop entry. Empty = use auto-extracted.

dialog.title: Sell-back Routing
dialog.typesHint: When players sell items, those matching these types land in this category. Items sold from a shop's stock route back to the matching category by type.
dialog.noTypes: No item types available in the current system.
dialog.fallbackHint: Items whose type doesn't match any other category's accepted types land in this category instead.

bulkImport.nothingToImport: Nothing to import — pick a source first.

stockPool.presetHint: Save weighted pools here to reuse them in any Stylish Shop category in this world.
stockPool.presetMissing: That stock pool preset no longer exists.
stockPool.presetOverwriteConfirm: A stock pool preset named "{name}" already exists. Overwrite it?
stockPool.presetDeleteConfirm: Delete the stock pool preset "{name}"? This does not change categories that already loaded it.
stockPool.noTables: No roll tables found in this world.
stockPool.rollTableHint: Item results become pool entries; their table weights are imported as entry weights. Text results are ignored.
stockPool.noEntries: No entries yet. Pick a source and refresh.
stockPool.noPreview: No preview yet. Roll to see what would be added.
stockPool.appliedReplace: Stock pool applied: category now has {replaced} items, {skipped} skipped.

actorsWalletDialog.title: Stylish Shop — Player Wallets
actorsWalletDialog.heading: Player Virtual Currency Wallets
actorsWalletDialog.hint: Edit virtual currency balances for every player character. Sheet currencies (system coins) are managed on each actor sheet.
actorsWalletDialog.libUnavailable: GlitchSmith Library is not active. Virtual currency support requires the library.
actorsWalletDialog.noCurrencies: No virtual currencies are defined yet. Open Currency Settings and add some.
actorsWalletDialog.noActors: No player-owned characters found in this world.

shopDirectory.title: Shop Directory
shopDirectory.gmHint: GMs can open every configured shop here. Players only see shops marked as public in Shop Settings.
shopDirectory.playerHint: Open public shops without standing near a token.
shopDirectory.selectBuyerHint: Pick which character will enter this shop.
shopDirectory.noBuyerActors: No owned player characters are available.

config.priceMultiplierHint: All item prices are multiplied by this value. 1.0 = normal price.
config.priceVarianceHint: Shop-wide default that randomizes each item's price by up to this percent (e.g. 10 = -10% to +10%). 0 = off. The variance is built from the manual per-shop price when one is set, otherwise the source item price, and each item can override this default in its row.

sale.enabledHint: While on, every purchase price in this shop gets the extra sale discount below. It combines with item and personal discounts and offsets any Hostile Relationship markup.
sale.timeModeHint: Real time ends the sale by the actual clock. Game time ends it by the world's game clock (Smartphone Widget, calendar modules, or core world time).
sale.endsAtHint: Optional real-world end time. Leave empty to keep the sale running until you turn it off.
sale.gameOpenEnded: No end date - keep running until I turn it off
sale.gameNoEnd: No end set — the sale runs until you turn it off.
sale.gameEndsAtHint: Pick the exact end date on the active game calendar. Month names and day limits come from the current game-time source.
sale.gameSourceChanged: The world's game clock changed since this end time was set, so it can't be judged anymore — the sale stays on until you end it or pick a new game date.

giftRewards.label: Complimentary Gift Program
giftRewards.title: Gift Rewards
giftRewards.hint: These are shop-level promotions, separate from catalog items. Drag an Item here, set the required lifetime spend, and choose whether it is claimed once or relocks for another spending cycle. The same Item can still be sold normally in a category.
giftRewards.dropHint: Drag a world, compendium, or Actor Item onto this reward.
giftRewards.sourceMissing: Source Item cannot currently be resolved.
giftRewards.invalid: Every gift reward needs an Item and a positive spend threshold. Fix or remove incomplete rows before saving.

personalDiscounts.label: Personal Discounts
personalDiscounts.hint: Per-buyer discounts that stack with the shop multiplier and each item's discount. Pick a buyer actor and set a percent (0-100); that buyer pays less when purchasing here. Purchases only, not sales.
personalDiscounts.dropHint: You can also drop a player's actor here

affinity.label: Relationship Benefits
affinity.hint: Stylish Relationship Tracker owns every buyer's state, rank, and progress. Positive benefits discount purchases; Hostile benefits mark them up. Markups and other discounts offset each other. Changing a benefit's state also changes the requirement for items linked to it.
affinity.enabled: Use Relationship benefits in this shop
affinity.relationshipAvailable: Stylish Relationship Tracker is active. Each buyer's single visible, unlocked Relationship targeting this shop Actor is linked by state and rank.
affinity.relationshipNotInstalled: Install and activate Stylish Relationship Tracker to configure affinity and rank benefits. Stylish Shop does not store a separate affinity score.
affinity.relationshipInactive: Stylish Relationship Tracker is installed but inactive. Activate it in Manage Modules to configure affinity and rank benefits.
affinity.relationshipNeedsUpdate: Stylish Relationship Tracker is active, but the required integration API is unavailable. Update the tracker before configuring affinity and rank benefits.
affinity.ownerNote: Relationship Tracker is the single source of truth. Stylish Shop stores only price adjustments, greetings, NPC art, and item unlocks assigned to each state and rank.
affinity.legacyNeedsReview: Legacy point tiers were converted to sequential Relationship ranks. Review the rank assignments before enabling these benefits.
affinity.duplicateRanks: Each Relationship state and rank combination must be unique. These combinations are assigned more than once: {ranks}.
affinity.spendToProgressHint: Base currency units per 1 Relationship progress step earned from successful purchases. Purchase progress moves in the Positive direction, reconciling Hostile relationships. 0 disables it.
affinity.greetingPlaceholder: Greeting at this state and rank or higher (optional)
affinity.npcArtPlaceholder: Image at this state and rank or higher (optional)
affinity.pickNpcArt: Choose state and rank NPC art

config.priceCurrencyHint: Force every price into one currency. Native keeps each item's own denominations; pick a currency to convert and pay/sell only in it (e.g. PF2e 2 gp shows as 20 bc).
config.noItemsInCategory: No items added yet. Drag items from the sidebar to add them.

sell.title: Sell Settings
sell.allowSellHint: Enable the sell mode in the shop UI for players.
sell.acceptingSellsHint: Toggle this to temporarily refuse sells without disabling the feature.
sell.sellPriceModifierHint: Multiplier applied to the item's price when selling. 0.5 = half price, 1.0 = full price, 1.5 = 50% bonus.
sell.infiniteFundsHint: If checked, the shop pays without checking its own currency balance.
sell.keepSoldItemsHint: If checked, items sold to the shop are added to its first category for buyback.
sell.mergeSoldStacksHint: When keeping sold items, merge identical items into existing entries instead of creating duplicates.

manager.title: Marketplace Categories
manager.intro: Create departments shared by every Stylish Shop and the smartphone marketplace.
manager.inferenceHint: Built-in categories can be inferred automatically. Renaming one changes only its display name, not its classification rules or ID. Assign custom categories explicitly in a shop category or individual product.
manager.gmOnly: Only a GM can manage marketplace categories.
manager.name: Category name
manager.builtInNameHint: Leave blank to use the translated default. Automatic classification keeps using this built-in category ID.
manager.deleteWarning: Click delete once more to remove this category. Existing mappings will move to the built-in fallback category when you save.
manager.deleteQueued: Category removed from this draft. Save changes to apply it.
manager.deleteHint: Deleting a custom category never deletes products or stock. Only its mappings move to the built-in fallback category.
manager.nameRequired: Every custom category needs a name.
manager.savedWithRemap: Marketplace categories saved. {count} existing mappings moved to the built-in fallback category.
manager.saveFailed: Marketplace categories could not be saved. No category definitions were removed.
